recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO decides to create new substantive guidance for multi-select observations beyond the existing component-versus-independent-observation distinction.
issue_request: FHIR-14031 asked the OO work group to clarify Observation Grouping guidance for observations with multi-select answers or values, using examples such as alcohol type with Wine, Beer, and Liquor values. The final Jira resolution was Published/Persuasive and stated that the change was pre-applied by adding an alcohol-type example and listing this as a component use case in the notes section.
initial_application: Commit f35b3850a7c3e70e64969237319c1b32fb4e943e, 'GF#13872 make notes section pretty, partially preapply GF#14036 and #14031', added source/observation/observation-example-alcohol-type.xml and added a bullet in Observation.component guidance for representing multiple answers to a question.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observation content is in current build scope. Current source/observation/observation-notes.xml still includes the multi-answer Observation.component bullet and links to the alcohol-type example. The example is present and registered in source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml. The linked Zulip thread supports the same nuanced rule: components are appropriate when the answers need collective interpretation, while independent observations may be appropriate when answers stand alone. No Confluence references were found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the Jira resolution, and additional wording would duplicate existing guidance rather than correct a semantic gap.
